about: Strings in the code that look like English text but never show in the UI (CSS, keys, patterns, data). The UI text check skips them.
strings: script, noscript, iframe, frame, frameset, object, embed, applet, base, portal, picture > source, video > source, audio > source, track
script, style, noscript, template, nav, aside, button, select, option, textarea, svg, math, iframe, [hidden]
